data.one_liner: Print receipts via ESC/POS over Wi‑Fi/Ethernet printers
data.what_it_does: This package provides a simple API to connect to ESC/POS thermal printers over a network and send print jobs. It supports Android, iOS, Windows, Linux and macOS.
use_when: You need to print receipts from a networked thermal printer
Your project is Flutter or pure Dart and you want a cross‑platform solution
You prefer a lightweight dependency without Bluetooth support
avoid_when: You are printing to a Bluetooth printer (use esc_pos_bluetooth)
You need advanced barcode or PDF‑417 support not yet implemented
strengths: Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, macOS)
Built on flutter_esc_pos_utils for styling and ticket generation
weaknesses: Limited to network printers listening on port 9100
Feature set is basic compared to full ESC/POS command coverage
